title: Living a Worthy Life in Obedience
summary: A noble life is found through obedience to Allah.
translation: A person should live their worldly life in a dignified manner. When will a dignified life be spent? When a person utilizes their time and life moments in obedience to Allah. If he conforms his time to God’s law and His obedience, the benefit will be that this act and his time will become everlasting. The reason is that although he may not remain in this world, the reward in the afterlife for his good deeds will be eternal. It is understood that if he made his time useful by living in obedience to Allah in this world, then a priceless, eternal life will be his destiny. Therefore, time should be made useful, and life should be lived in a dignified manner. It is not about living imitating any random person's behavior or character. Instead, Islam is entirely civil and peaceful. Every wish can be fulfilled and every lesson learned from it. There is no aspect of life that is not found here, and no instructions available. Therefore, we should strive to shape our lives according to Islam in every matter. May Allah make us all live dignified lives. The Prophet's (SAW) Hadith states that the righteous people will gradually leave the world, and those who are useless will not be of any concern to Allah, remaining like chaff in the world. It shows that Allah values righteous people, so He calls them soon. Bad people are not valued by Allah, so they remain. Hence, we must live life as good people, esteemed by Allah, and live shaping ourselves according to Shariah and by making our time useful.
